question: In Formula 1 seasons since 2001, considering only drivers who scored points in a season, which five constructors have had the most seasons where their drivers scored the fewest total points among all point-scoring drivers in that season?
sql:
WITH constructor_points AS (
    SELECT ra.year, c.constructor_id, SUM(r.points) as total_points
    FROM results r
    JOIN races ra ON r.race_id = ra.race_id
    JOIN constructors c ON r.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
    WHERE r.points > 0 AND ra.year >= 2001
    GROUP BY ra.year, c.constructor_id
),
min_points_per_year AS (
    SELECT year, MIN(total_points) as min_points
    FROM constructor_points
    GROUP BY year
),
min_constructors AS (
    SELECT cp.year, cp.constructor_id, cp.total_points, mpy.min_points
    FROM constructor_points cp
    JOIN min_points_per_year mpy ON cp.year = mpy.year AND cp.total_points = mpy.min_points
)
SELECT c.name, COUNT(*) as seasons_with_min_points
FROM min_constructors mc
JOIN constructors c ON mc.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
GROUP BY c.constructor_id, c.name
ORDER BY seasons_with_min_points DESC, c.name
LIMIT 5
